outcome.technical: New tools/check-browser-install.py (stdlib, 3.8 floor): reads the committed .github/actions/browser-install/action.yml with a subset reader (any other shape is a named problem), executes its pins, plan and sysdeps-install run: blocks under bash --noprofile --norc -eo pipefail against stubs (sudo, apt-get, apt-config, mkdir, cp, chown, ownership ledger; each stub a sh wrapper re-entering this file with --stub NAME). Cases bi1-bi10 (system packages' step; bi1 red on a hit that fetches anything, bi10 ownership), sp1-sp6 (one per seed decision), sk1-sk3 (keys), sd1-sd3 (lookup/restore/plan wiring read off step keys). Docstring states what the stubs cannot see. Selftest: parser cases bp1-bp5, every case over the committed action, mutation rows bm1-bm16 (anchor must occur exactly once, named cases must go red and be green on the committed action); on a non-POSIX host the gate is red 'could not run here' and the selftest records a _harness.skip. Added to verify.sh's lint slice (ubuntu lint job, per-run). ci.yml: both browser jobs' install step gets id install and continue-on-error: ${{ needs.verified.outputs.run != '' }}, plus a 'seed: say that the install failed' step writing ::warning:: when steps.install.outcome == 'failure' on the seed path; on dispatch/PR run is '' so continue-on-error is false, the warning step skipped, seed false and the slice step unchanged (acceptance 4). longest browser-report: 18m23s (run 44426388905, 00:07:12 to 00:25:35), bound 28 -> 37 (gate-parity job_bound_evidence green). gate-parity.py: _step_runs returns each step's if: and continue-on-error: at item depth whichever key opens the item; new _may_fail(): a step or job running verify.sh with continue-on-error other than literal false is a job finding; cases sv24 (the '- name:' first form, both directions), sv25 (red: step true, step expression, job), sv26 (allow: the seed's shape, a literal false). gate-parity mutations in memory: G1 never-fires -> sv25 red; G3 false-read-as-may-fail -> sv26 red; G4 keys off opening line only -> sv24,sv25 red; G5 job key unread -> sv25 red; G6 key read anywhere in the job's text -> sv7,sv25,sv26 red. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE section 4: the false 'runs only tools/ci-verified.py' sentence replaced by what a verified push runs and what a seed costs. CONTRIBUTING: seed failure rule, the new check, _may_fail in gate-parity's list. action.yml: header note only, no shell changed. SEED PATH ON A RUNNER (probe branch ci/P169-seed-probe3, commit 4580b756 = d31ba046 + this diff + a probe-only seed: "true" line not in this tree): run 44426388905 (dispatch 1) both jobs 'Cache not found for input keys: playwright-browsers-Linux-X64-1.56.0-v1' and '...chromium-sysdeps-ubuntu24-X64-13eb79dcfbc2ac23-v1', plan 'seed: no entry exists for the browser key and the system packages' key, so the install runs and this job saves what it fetched', 'no restored set: ...', panel post 'Cache saved with key: chromium-sysdeps-...' and '... playwright-browsers-...', report post 'Failed to save: Unable to reserve cache with key ...'; run 44428930205 (dispatch 2) both jobs 'Cache found and can be restored from key: ...' for both keys, plan 'seed: an entry exists for every key this image needs, so nothing is installed and nothing is saved', no restore/fetch/save, action about 4s (panel 00:26:07.05-00:26:10.81, report 00:26:13.74-00:26:17.01); both jobs red only because the probe's slice step ran with no browser installed (Playwright precondition, 'panel + report preconditions: FAILED'), which a real seed never does since its slice step is skipped. Both runs also red on selftests (windows, plain 3) test__commit_trail vt8, fixed on the branch after d31ba046. Report job walls, each a fact with its run: 13m35s (44385960921), 16m09s (44397426313), 17m54s (44424245100), 18m23s (44426388905); the wall is dominated by the slice (11m38s in 44426388905) plus a mirror-dependent install (about 36s in the panel job and 6m21s in the report job for the same 21.1 MB in one run); neither is this task's to shorten, and only the one longest line is in a document. Still unobserved: a seed on main from a real verified push, and another branch restoring main's entry; a job past timeout-minutes is still cancelled (continue-on-error does not cover it). Commands, exit codes: python3 tools/gate-parity.py exit 0 (14 slices, 7 jobs); python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test__deps.py tests/test__output_lints.py tests/test__refs.py tools/_suite.py tools/gate-parity.py tools/check-browser-install.py exit 0 ('6/6 files ok, 973 cases'; check-browser-install 43, gate-parity 134); --encoding cp1252 --spaced over the check exit 0 (43 cases, stage 1); python3 tools/check-browser-install.py exit 0 (22 of 22); ruff exit 0; vermin -t=3.8- exit 0. Dependants: gate-parity slice/step/bound rules extended and green (sv7 live claim green); verify.sh one step added to lint, no slice renamed; sweep isolation held (plain, cp1252, spaced; fixtures under mkdtemp, removed in finally; no network, no real sudo/apt); _deps needs no row for tools/*.py (test__deps green); _suite rules green; tools/affected.py (outside files) treats the action as UNRECOGNISED and selects the full set; CLAUDE.md (outside files) no longer exact in 'every CI job is setup plus one tools/verify.sh --only <slices> call' (browser jobs carry an install and a warning step; verified runs none) and its enumeration of what gate-parity checks about slices lacks the never-allowed-to-fail rule; .github/sweep-costs.json has no figure for the new file (floor timeout).
outcome.descriptive: The browser install's shell is now executed against stubs in the lint slice (red on a hit that falls back and on the first probe's ownership defect), its seed path was seen miss-then-save and hit-skip on a runner, and a seed can no longer redden a verified push while a slice can never be the step allowed to fail.
